{"code": "    def scan_for_secrets(self, text: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return a list of findings for every secret detected in *text*.

        BUG_70: Only plaintext patterns are checked.  Base64-encoded
        segments are never decoded and re-scanned, so an encoded
        ``AKIA...`` key or ``ghp_`` token slips through undetected.
        """
        from orgops import alerts

        self.findings = []
        self._scan_plaintext(text)
        for encoded in _BASE64_RE.finditer(text):
            decoded = self._try_decode_base64(encoded.group())
            if decoded is None:
                continue
            self._scan_plaintext(decoded)
        for finding in self.findings:
            alerts.notify(finding)
        return list(self.findings)", "comments": "Decode and rescan base64 segments for secrets and notify orgops alerts for each finding."}
